Morning announcement for pet owners
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Pet Travel Notice

Travelers should check their animal documents and crate details before they come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep pets calm, secure, and ready for inspection. If you are traveling with a reptile, <<FACT F060>> Bring any required papers, and make sure the carrier is clean, closed, and easy to handle. Staff will review the setup and may ask you to adjust it before acceptance. For a small dog, <<FACT F068>> Use a sturdy crate, allow room for the animal to stand and turn, and place a soft lining inside.

If your plans change, tell the desk as soon as possible so we can update the booking record and guide you through the next steps. Travelers should also avoid loose tags, open food, and unsafe leashes near the check-in area. We aim to keep companion travel steady and clear for every animal and owner who arrives prepared.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you go to the gate.
